description: Set how a child behaves in an auto-layout frame: alignment (STRETCH), growth (fill container) and absolute positioning.

layoutAlign.description: Counter-axis alignment: STRETCH to fill width/height

layoutGrow.description: Primary-axis growth: 0 = fixed size, 1 = fill available space

layoutPositioning.description: AUTO = follow auto-layout, ABSOLUTE = manually positioned

name: figma_set_layout_align
